requirements.title: Fresh genuine preparation
requirements.requirement: Only actual branded same-store preparation of the complete final context, current memory, complete examined source identity and task/auth snapshot can authorize new normal work. Historical reads, shape-matched JSON and old cached readiness do not issue authority.

requirements.title: Whole consent and limits
requirements.requirement: Owner sees and explicitly accepts complete prefix, whole current context, actual model/preset/tools/permission/source/backend, all 15 accepted limits, spent/remaining and separate plan/preview/grant deadlines. Consent is exact and does not itself grant or start work.

requirements.title: Explicit new continuation
requirements.requirement: Only an eligible genuinely released producer lineage can continue. A new cold runtime uses the genuine installed producer source support adoptSignedResumePlan({taskRef,contextRecordRef,spec,actionDigest,resumeRef}):void with the complete original authenticated signed spec and full equality, preserving native agent/session identity and task while new charged claim/generation/execution identity is distinct. No caller signature parameter exists.

requirements.title: Original composition and publication
requirements.requirement: Original Context, Loader, Registry, AgentLoop, LlmRuntime, SessionStore, JSONL, Approval, Preset, NativeAdapter and WorkerManager own all lifecycle objects and effects. Actual session/created and agent/created announcements and paired rollback/disposal are observed; no synthetic handle/carrier is admissible.

requirements.title: Complete original native facts
requirements.requirement: Capture/recovery observes complete contiguous seq-0 persisted events, actual header/surface/messages/current registered projections, empty reconstructed inbox and no interrupted closers, complete retained current Session, and native assistant/message TokenUsage for the actual turn.

requirements.title: No implicit replay
requirements.requirement: Boot/status/history/finish-command reads cannot execute pending commands, manufacture permits, stop a worker, create a successor or replay an external effect. Truthful original workerObservation writes are separately counted rather than prohibited.

requirements.title: Trusted isolation and CAS
requirements.requirement: Actual owner/workspace/task/role and current authenticated handles control access. Payload claims do not authorize. New claims, grants and intents bind exact action/spec/current taskVersion/authEpoch; historical exact lookup follows actual present read authority.

requirements.title: Revoke/cancel linearization
requirements.requirement: Cancellation, revocation, source/provider/policy change and captured invocation loss recheck at admitted public asynchronous dispatch boundaries. Denied before claim sends nothing; charged uncertain failures retain accountable reservations and never borrow new live objects.

requirements.title: Capture before immutable owner intent
requirements.requirement: Original output capture and every chosen review-report/repair-artifact commit precede constructing exact eight-field Q from the actual refreshed current task. First intent durably binds that original committed output and authentic execution/role facts before actual owned stop.

requirements.title: Factual stop then readonly reobservation
requirements.requirement: After genuine owned AgentHandle.dispose drains, unregisters and removes the live session, original readonly collection reobserves complete JSONL, retained Session and current-turn native usage. Native stop, terminal evidence and usage cannot be inferred from missing handles or cachedValidatedFacts.

requirements.title: Same Q and conservative failure
requirements.requirement: Final finish uses precisely the recorded immutable original Q/CAS, never fresh/predicted Q. Mutation, replacement, unknown stop, stale CAS or failed final commit leaves truthful pending/unknown/reservations unless genuine original settlement establishes release; no unconditional release.

requirements.title: Authentic command history
requirements.requirement: Record/read/list expose only closed authentic unreceived/intent_committed/finish_committed/legacy_unrestorable DTOs. Exact duplicates reproduce unchanged Q/digest/receipt before current-CAS/native checks; mismatches conflict under original validation/access precedence. Legacy unavailable is not backfill or stop permission.

requirements.title: Honest readonly freshness
requirements.requirement: Readonly JSONL may memo by dev/ino/size/mtimeNs/ctimeNs. Persistence revisions are same-instance/session opaque tokens. Reads started after local completed append/flush observe at least that prefix; physical reads concurrent with mutation are nonatomic. No force-read, filesystemCAS, expectedRevision/maxRead resume option or atomic physical snapshot claim.

requirements.title: Conservation
requirements.requirement: Charged attempts remain per-task across groups, roles and continuation ordinals; whole-store runtime/usage/cost and active holds persist across settlement/reopen. Selected source reports actual UTF8 full-request/output byte counters through original native TokenUsage with explicit df-testing-utf8-byte-units/v1/source_zero accounting; native provenance and receipt carriers stay distinct. This is not a conversion for arbitrary provider tokens; unknown never becomes zero.

requirements.title: Finite capacity and reachability
requirements.requirement: Configuration, history/request/result/material/metadata/data/command limits are joint. At most 16 associated owner command IDs and complete success-wrapper bound 65536 apply without padding, forged facts, increased ceilings or eviction. Numeric ceiling eligibility alone does not prove high positive reachability.

requirements.title: Races and recovery
requirements.requirement: Finite competing identical/different finish commands and same-predecessor/last-slot continuation races retain one authoritative outcome and no duplicated native publication/effect; actual process recovery reconciles authentic durable facts without restoring old capabilities.

requirements.title: Independent gate retained
requirements.requirement: This is design only. Root freezes code/package/effects and owns separate GO. Existing 26 preparation families retain their results; all 87 criteria accepted 0/HOLD, physical/UI/migration/private experiments and the protected final CODE gap remain separate.

publicOracles.recipe: Register observers via original Context.on before actual source dispatch. Let original session/created, agent/created source startup|resume, agent/status, session/event, agent/assistant-stream, agent/disposed, session/disposed invoke observers naturally. Never emit events or call callbacks manually. Observe actual registry/store entries and owning handle capability, not detached DTO shape. Creation listener cannot await its own disposal or agent.whenIdle.

publicOracles.name: Complete readonly durable prefix
publicOracles.recipe: Require successful actual flush barrier when needed; actual backend.stat physical size preflight; original open(id,'read'); read from0 with selected cap+1 to detect overflow; close in finally. Compare exact header/id/cwd/preset/inherited cut, contiguous complete events, actual surface/messages, whole context/source/current guards and original current-turn usage. No capped-slice approval. Backend may memo; returned count is not a hard decode/read/allocation bound. Concurrent physical read is nonatomic.

publicOracles.name: Actual retained Session and registered reconstruction
publicOracles.recipe: Retain exact original agent.session from genuine publication. Compare header/id/seq/surface/deriveMessages and natural event feed with the complete current genuine NativeHistoryObservation from an existing supported public collector phase and independent readonly JSONL data. For detached observation use Session.create(...actual messageProjections) and sessionProjections.restore(...full events,baseSeq0), actual inbox present/empty and interruptedTurnClosers empty. Scalar seq/messages alone do not prove full non-surface event equality. No new deprecated snapshotEvents/eventAt/ownEvents call, private snapshot/reducer, synthetic seeded live session or fabricated history. Missing full-retained public observation leaves that cell HOLD.

publicOracles.name: Actual stop/reobservation/settlement ordering
publicOracles.recipe: Q is constructed only after actual original output and chosen report/artifact commits, then refreshed workerQuery Task or factual original returned task. Normal installed workerFinish starts from unreceived Q; do not test-prewrite its intent. Core-only record tests are separate. Factual owned dispose and permitted public pending-before-stop witness are distinct. AFTER actual disposal recollection must match complete JSONL/retained history/native usage; immutable Q stays unchanged. A post-return committed DTO cannot by itself prove timing; absence of a handle cannot prove stop.

publicOracles.name: Conserved public durable accounting
publicOracles.recipe: Compare original spent/remaining/claim/reservation/task/worker/capture/finish DTOs and actual current-turn native counters after each finite action. Attempts per task across all groups/roles/ordinals; active/runtime/usage/cost whole-store. Actual released spend persists, unknown holds never zero, and original role completion/release evidence is required. Operational equality is not encrypted-cipher/AAD/SQL/cryptographic proof.

firstFailureStop.rule: On first unexpected field/state/authority/source/lifecycle/usage/accounting/limit/order/effect mismatch, timeout, runtime-policy denial, source-pin drift or unobservable claimed boundary: stop admitting new work, do no fresh Q/retry/fallback/alternate route, mark affected cell and downstream dependencies HOLD, notify root with exact ID/allowed stable code/refs/digests/counters. Expected public refusal is a negative oracle, not a suite failure. Genuine original cleanup may physically stop only own resources, without ledger release/backfill or false terminal proof.
firstFailureStop.timeouts: All public waits are finite per-cell <=30000ms; optional maintenance/drain/stop ordering <=5000ms. No listener waits for itself. Release test-owned mock/maintenance await promptly on timeout, then ordinary own disposal only.
firstFailureStop.evidence: Record active declaration/source pins, exact own scope/task/action/claim/generation/execution/command refs, actual Q versions, original public DTO state/receipt/digests, actual event/byte/model/claim counts, exact observed boundary and root disposition; no raw personal payloads/secrets/full error objects.

cleanup.rule: Stop new dispatch; cancel/close only actual test-owned WorkerManager/NativeAdapter tickets/AgentHandle returned through original factory ownership, await original drain and every readonly SessionHandle.close in finally, then actual original plugin Fiber.dispose/Loader disposal. AgentRegistry.get returns bare Agent and never authorizes disposal. Do not manually unregister or delete DB/native state, reset accounting, synthesize terminal/release evidence, make a fresh Q, replay or broaden scope. Preserve failed pending/unknown/reservations and approved evidence for root. Root decides later path deletion after evidence, never this design.
